title: MBESO2D: An open MATLAB implementation of stress-state-based multi-material BESO
description: MBESO2D is an open MATLAB implementation of stress-state-based multi-material bi-directional evolutionary structural optimization for two-dimensional continua. It supports retained-solid regions, line loads, and self-weight. The repository includes compact solvers, explanatory comments, an equation-to-code map, numerical records, scripts for reproducing manuscript figures and tables, and verification experiments for sensitivity and material-assignment histories. The documentation defines the scope and limitations of the numerical comparisons.
